description: Sulfurous Icon Item Level 1 Binds when picked up Unique Relic Totem Classes: Shaman Engrave your gloves with the Molten Blast rune: Blast up to 10 enemies in a cone in front of you for [(7.583798 + 0.471881 * 60 + 0.036599 * 60 * 60) * 72 / 100 + 5 / 100 * Attack Power] to [(7.583798 + 0.471881 * 60 + 0.036599 * 60 * 60) * 108 / 100 + 5 / 100 * Attack Power] Fire damage. This ability generates a high amount of threat. Flame Shock periodic damage has a 10% chance to reset the cooldown on Molten Blast. "Learn a new ability after defeating 10 enemies with Earth Shock." Added in Season of Discovery. May not be in WoW: Forever.
